title: How Much Does Healthcare Lead Generation Cost? Pricing Models for Clinics and Medical Practices (2026)
unsourced_claims: Search-ad leads averaged $66.02 in LocaliQ's healthcare benchmarks, and agency retainers for independent practices are commonly quoted at $2,500–$10,000 a month, with ad spend billed on top.
Mixing them up is why you see $50 and $800 healthcare lead generation cost claims on the same search page.
The most-cited benchmark is $66.02 per lead for healthcare search ads, from LocaliQ.
By specialty, it ranges from about $18.54 for dermatology to $141.17 for mental health.
That's why dermatology CPL sits near $18.54 in LocaliQ's search data, while some agencies publish blended figures of $50–$140 for the same specialty.
For an independent practice, expect about $2,500–$10,000 a month in fees, with media on top.
Multi-location groups are commonly quoted around $6,000–$15,000 a month plus media, since each added location brings its own listings, landing pages, call tracking and reporting.
Say you buy 100 leads at $60, which is $6,000.
